paragraphs.text: Swimming outdoors in winter has grown from a hobby of a few enthusiasts into a popular social activity. In one coastal town, a club that started with six members in 2015 now has more than 400.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Members often say that a swim in cold water improves their mood for the rest of the day. Scientists believe this may be linked to the release of hormones when the body is suddenly cooled, although most studies so far have been small.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: The activity is not without risk. The shock of entering very cold water causes rapid breathing, which can lead to panic, and swimmers who stay in too long may lose strength in their arms and legs. Clubs therefore advise newcomers to enter the water slowly and to swim close to the shore.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: After leaving the water, swimmers should dress quickly and have a warm drink, but doctors warn against taking a hot shower straight away, because a sudden change in temperature can make some people feel faint.
paragraphs.label: D

items.quote: a club that started with six members in 2015
items.prompt: The club in the coastal town had only six members when it 1 ____.

explanation.en: “a club that started with six members in 2015” → started. A past-tense verb is needed; “2015” and “400” do not fit the sentence.
explanation.kk: «a club that started with six members in 2015» → started. Өткен шақтағы етістік керек; «2015» мен «400» сөйлем мағынасына келмейді.
explanation.ru: «a club that started with six members in 2015» → started. Нужен глагол в прошедшем времени; «2015» и «400» не подходят по смыслу предложения.

items.quote: a swim in cold water improves their mood for the rest of the day
items.prompt: Many members say that a cold swim improves their 2 ____.

explanation.en: “improves their mood for the rest of the day” → mood. After “their” we need a noun.
explanation.kk: «improves their mood for the rest of the day» → mood. «Their» сөзінен кейін зат есім керек.
explanation.ru: «improves their mood for the rest of the day» → mood. После «their» нужно существительное.

items.quote: most studies so far have been small
items.prompt: According to scientists, most research on the benefits has been 3 ____.

explanation.en: On the research the text says: “most studies so far have been small”. After “has been” the adjective from the text is needed — small.
explanation.kk: Ғылыми деректер туралы: «most studies so far have been small». «Has been» тіркесінен кейін мәтіндегі сын есім керек — small.
explanation.ru: О научных данных сказано: «most studies so far have been small». После «has been» нужно прилагательное из текста — small.

items.quote: causes rapid breathing, which can lead to panic
items.prompt: Entering very cold water causes rapid breathing, which can result in 4 ____.

explanation.en: Rapid breathing, the text says, “can lead to panic”. “Result in” means the same as “lead to”, so the answer is panic.
explanation.kk: Мәтін бойынша жиі тыныс алу «can lead to panic». Сөйлемдегі «result in» — «lead to» дегенмен бірдей, сондықтан жауап panic.
explanation.ru: Быстрое дыхание, по тексту, «can lead to panic». «Result in» в предложении значит то же, что «lead to», поэтому ответ panic.

items.quote: doctors warn against taking a hot shower straight away
items.prompt: Doctors advise swimmers not to take a hot 5 ____ immediately after swimming.

explanation.en: “doctors warn against taking a hot shower straight away” → shower. A warm “drink” is actually recommended.
explanation.kk: «doctors warn against taking a hot shower straight away» → shower. «Drink» да жылы, бірақ оны, керісінше, ішу ұсынылады.
explanation.ru: «doctors warn against taking a hot shower straight away» → shower. «Drink» тоже тёплый, но его как раз советуют.
